/*RlkCheck.selectDeptList*/ SELECT B.DEPT_CD AS DGRCOMPO_ID , 'ROOT' AS UP_DGRCOMPO_ID , 0 AS "LEVEL" , 'true' AS IS_LEAF , 'true' AS EXPANDED , 'true' AS LOADED , B.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , B.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , B.OFFICE_CD AS OFFICE_CD , B.OFFICE_NM AS OFFICE_NM , B.OFFICE_RANK AS OFFICE_RANK , B.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , B.DEPT_NM AS DEPT_NM , B.DEPT_RANK AS DEPT_RANK , NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DGRCOMPO Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = B.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = B.BGT_DGR AND Z.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD AND Z.COMPO_LEVEL = '1'), 0) AS DBIZ_CNT FROM TB_DGRDEPT B WHERE B.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND B.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr#
AND B.OFFICE_CD = #officeCd#
AND B.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #srchNm# || '%'
ORDER BY B.OFFICE_RANK , B.OFFICE_CD , B.DEPT_RANK , B.DEPT_CD

/*RlkCheck.selectDgrcompoList*/ SELECT T.DGRCOMPO_ID AS DGRCOMPO_ID , T.UP_DGRCOMPO_ID AS UP_DGRCOMPO_ID , T.DGR_LEVEL AS DGR_LEVEL , T.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , T.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , T.DEPT_CD AS DEPT_CD , T.DBIZ_CD AS DBIZ_CD , T.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AS TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , T.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ AS TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , CAST((T.PRE_AMT/DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS PRE_AMT , CAST((T.DEMAND_DIFF_AMT/DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS DEMAND_DIFF_AMT , CAST((T.DEMAND_BGT_AMT/DECODE(#amtUnit#, NULL, 1, '', 1, '0', 1, #amtUnit#)) AS NUMERIC(19,0)) AS DEMAND_BGT_AMT , NVL((SELECT Z.FIS_FG_NM FROM TB_YEARFISFG Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.FIS_FG_CD = T.FIS_FG_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') AS FIS_FG_NM , NVL((SELECT Z.OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.OFFICE_CD = T.OFFICE_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') AS OFFICE_NM , NVL((SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.DEPT_CD = T.DEPT_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') AS DEPT_NM , NVL((SELECT Z.DBIZ_NM FROM TB_DGRBIZ Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.DBIZ_CD = T.DBIZ_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') AS DBIZ_NM , NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPORT WHERE FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = T.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID AND REPORT_CD IN ('010', '020', '040', '050', '055', '060', '090') ), 0) AS REPORT_CNT , TRIM(CASE WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL = 0 THEN NVL((SELECT Z.FIS_FG_NM FROM TB_YEARFISFG Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.FIS_FG_CD = T.FIS_FG_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL = 1 THEN NVL((SELECT Z.OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.OFFICE_CD = T.OFFICE_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL = 2 THEN NVL((SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.DEPT_CD = T.DEPT_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL = 3 THEN NVL((SELECT Z.DBIZ_NM FROM TB_DGRBIZ Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = T.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = T.BGT_DGR AND Z.DBIZ_CD = T.DBIZ_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '(정보없음)') WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL = 4 THEN T.COMP_GROUND ELSE '' END) AS DGRCOMPO_NM , T.UP_DGRCOMPO_ID AS PARENT , CASE WHEN T.DGR_LEVEL >= 4 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS IS_LEAF , CASE WHEN 1 >= T.DGR_LEVEL THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS EXPANDED , 'true' AS LOADED , T.DGR_LEVEL AS "LEVEL" , 'N' AS SEL_YN FROM (SELECT DECODE(H.CT, 1, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || '0000' || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 2, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 3, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 4, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || A.DBIZ_CD || '_' || '00000000000' , 5, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || A.DBIZ_CD || '_' || A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID) AS DGRCOMPO_ID , DECODE(H.CT, 1, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || '000' || '_' || '0000' || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 2, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || '0000' || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 3, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 4, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 5, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || A.DBIZ_CD || '_' || '00000000000') AS UP_DGRCOMPO_ID , DECODE(H.CT, 1, 0, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4, 3, 4) AS DGR_LEVEL , A.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , DECODE(H.CT, 5, A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID, '00000000000') AS TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , DECODE(H.CT, 5, A.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ, 0) AS TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') AS FIS_FG_CD , DECODE(H.CT, 1, '0000', NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999')) AS OFFICE_CD , DECODE(H.CT, 1, '0000000', 2, '0000000', A.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_CD , DECODE(H.CT, 1, '0000000000000000', 2, '0000000000000000', 3, '0000000000000000', A.DBIZ_CD) AS DBIZ_CD , DECODE(H.CT, 5, A.COMP_GROUND, '') AS COMP_GROUND , SUM(DECODE(H.CT, 1, 0, 2, 0, 3, 0, 4, 0, A.PRE_AMT)) AS PRE_AMT , SUM(DECODE(H.CT, 1, 0, 2, 0, 3, 0, 4, 0, A.DEMAND_DIFF_AMT)) AS DEMAND_DIFF_AMT , SUM(DECODE(H.CT, 1, 0, 2, 0, 3, 0, 4, 0, A.DEMAND_BGT_AMT)) AS DEMAND_BGT_AMT FROM TB_DGRCOMPO A , TB_DGRDEPT B , TB_DGRBIZ C , (SELECT ROWNUM AS CT FROM TB_COMMCD WHERE ROWNUM BETWEEN 1 AND 5) H WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.FIS_YEAR(+) = A.FIS_YEAR AND B.BGT_DGR(+) = A.BGT_DGR AND B.DEPT_CD(+) = A.DEPT_CD AND C.FIS_YEAR(+) = A.FIS_YEAR AND C.BGT_DGR(+) = A.BGT_DGR AND C.DBIZ_CD(+) = A.DBIZ_CD AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND A.COMPO_LEVEL = '1'
AND NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') = #officeCd#
AND (A.COMP_GROUND LIKE '%' || #srchNm# || '%' OR NVL(B.DEPT_NM, '') LIKE '%' || #srchNm# || '%' OR NVL((SELECT Z.DBIZ_NM FROM TB_DGRBIZ Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND Z.DBIZ_CD = A.DBIZ_CD AND ROWNUM = 1), '') LIKE '%' || #srchNm# || '%')
GROUP BY DECODE(H.CT, 1, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || '0000' || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 2, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || '0000000' || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 3, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || '0000000000000000' || '_' || '00000000000' , 4, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || A.DBIZ_CD || '_' || '00000000000' , 5, A.FIS_YEAR || '_' || TO_CHAR(A.BGT_DGR, '000') || '_' || NVL(C.FIS_FG_CD, '999') || '_' || NVL(B.OFFICE_CD, '9999') || '_' || A.DEPT_CD || '_' || A.DBIZ_CD || '_' || A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID) ) T WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY T.FIS_YEAR , NVL(T.BGT_DGR, 0) , NVL(T.FIS_FG_CD, '999') , NVL(T.OFFICE_CD, '9999') , NVL(T.DEPT_CD, '0000000') , NVL(T.DBIZ_CD, '0000000000000000') , NVL(T.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID, '00000000000')
sqlMap.update: /*RlkCheck.updateDgrcompoDept*/ UPDATE TB_DGRCOMPO A SET DEPT_CD = #deptCd# , MODI_ID = #userId# , MODI_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND A.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID = #teBgtCompoId#
sqlMap.insert: /*RlkCheck.insertCngHistory*/ INSERT INTO TB_CNG_HISTORY ( CNG_HISTORY_ID , CNG_TYPE , TITLE , INDI_BNS , NOTE , REGI_ID , REGI_DATE , MODI_ID , MODI_DATE) VALUES( #cngHistoryId# , 'CH04' , #title# , #indiBns# , #note# , #userId# , SYSTIMESTAMP , #userId# , SYSTIMESTAMP)

/*RlkCheck.insertDgrCompoOri*/ INSERT INTO TB_DGRCOMPO_ORI ( FIS_YEAR , BGT_DGR , TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , CNG_HISTORY_ID , DEPT_CD , DBIZ_CD , TE_MNG_MOK_CD , TE_MNG_MOK_NM , TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , DEMAND_COMPO_SORT_SEQ , DEMAND_COMPO_LEVEL , DEMAND_COMP_GROUND , DEMAND_COMP_FORMULAR , DEMAND_BGT_AMT , DEMAND_DIFF_AMT , DEMAND_COMPO_LEVEL_AMT , DEMAND_FORM_DSP_YN , COMPO_SORT_SEQ , COMPO_LEVEL , COMP_GROUND , COMP_FORMULAR , BGT_AMT , PRE_FORMULAR , PRE_AMT , DIFF_AMT , COMPO_LEVEL_AMT , FORM_DSP_YN , UP_TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , UP_TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , SORT_SEQ , PRE_COMP_FORMULAR , PRE_BGT_AMT , CNG_TYPE , GRP_ID , GRP_LVL , REGI_ID , REGI_DATE , MODI_ID , MODI_DATE) SELECT TD1.FIS_YEAR , TD1.BGT_DGR , TD1.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , #cngHistoryId# AS CNG_HISTORY_ID , TD1.DEPT_CD , TD1.DBIZ_CD , TD1.TE_MNG_MOK_CD , TD1.TE_MNG_MOK_NM , TD1.TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , TD1.DEMAND_COMPO_SORT_SEQ , TD1.DEMAND_COMPO_LEVEL , TD1.DEMAND_COMP_GROUND , TD1.DEMAND_COMP_FORMULAR , TD1.DEMAND_BGT_AMT , TD1.DEMAND_DIFF_AMT , TD1.DEMAND_COMPO_LEVEL_AMT , TD1.DEMAND_FORM_DSP_YN , TD1.COMPO_SORT_SEQ , TD1.COMPO_LEVEL , TD1.COMP_GROUND , TD1.COMP_FORMULAR , TD1.BGT_AMT , TD1.PRE_FORMULAR , TD1.PRE_AMT , TD1.DIFF_AMT , TD1.COMPO_LEVEL_AMT , TD1.FORM_DSP_YN , TD1.UP_TE_BGT_COMPO_SEQ , TD1.UP_TE_BGT_COMPO_ID , TD1.SORT_SEQ , TD1.PRE_COMP_FORMULAR , TD1.PRE_BGT_AMT , TD1.CNG_TYPE , TD1.GRP_ID , TD1.GRP_LVL , #userId# , SYSTIMESTAMP , #userId# , SYSTIMESTAMP FROM TB_DGRCOMPO TD1 WHERE TD1.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND TD1.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND TD1.TE_BGT_COMPO_ID IN
#teBgtCompoIds[]#
